// The gaps of the diagnostic of the inserts (bench-report.md of
// feat/posting-edge-index, "Huecos del diagnóstico", pre-registered on
// 2026-11-28 by the user's order): measures only, over clones of the indexes
// of the diagnostic.

// diagCallerCtx gives the callers of a pass the concurrency budget of
// PE_CALLERBUDGET, which their plans keep for their reads: without it a plan
// reads with the fan-out of the index, twice GOMAXPROCS, which changes with
// GOMAXPROCS.
func diagCallerCtx(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context) context.Context {
	if budget := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_CALLERBUDGET", 0)); budget > 0 {
		return concurrency.CtxWithBudget(ctx, budget)
	}
	return ctx
}

// diagNoMaintenance has an index about to open do none of its maintenance
// in the background, with PE_NOMAINTENANCE: over the 10M index, which is not
// laid out, a pass of the layout starts as soon as it opens with room on the
// disk, and runs next to whatever is measured.
func diagNoMaintenance(cfg *PersistentConfig) bool {
	if os.Getenv("PE_NOMAINTENANCE") == "" {
		return false
	}
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	return true
}

// diagSettle waits, with PE_SETTLE, until the segments of the store under
// dir have stood as they are for that many seconds, PE_SETTLEMAX (300) at
// most: the store of a clone compacts what the growth left when its cycles
// start. It tells how long it waited.
func diagSettle(t *testing.T, dir string) float64 {
	quiet := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SETTLE", 0)) * time.Second
	if quiet <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	longest := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SETTLEMAX", 300)) * time.Second
	begin := time.Now()
	last, err := diagSegments(dir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	stood := time.Now()
	for time.Since(begin) < longest && time.Since(stood) < quiet {
		time.Sleep(time.Second)
		now, err := diagSegments(dir)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		same := len(now) == len(last)
		for bucket, count := range now {
			if last[bucket] != count {
				same = false
			}
		}
		if !same {
			last, stood = now, time.Now()
		}
	}
	return time.Since(begin).Seconds()
}

// diagPercentiles is the latencies of a set of durations, in ms.
type diagPercentiles struct {
	N    int     `json:"n"`
	Mean float64 `json:"meanms"`
	P50  float64 `json:"p50ms"`
	P95  float64 `json:"p95ms"`
	P99  float64 `json:"p99ms"`
	P999 float64 `json:"p999ms"`
	Max  float64 `json:"maxms"`
}

func diagPercentilesOf(samples []time.Duration) diagPercentiles {
	out := diagPercentiles{N: len(samples)}
	if len(samples) == 0 {
		return out
	}
	sorted := make([]float64, len(samples))
	for i, s := range samples {
		sorted[i] = float64(s) / float64(time.Millisecond)
		out.Mean += sorted[i] / float64(len(samples))
	}
	slices.Sort(sorted)
	at := func(q float64) float64 {
		return sorted[max(0, min(len(sorted)-1, int(math.Ceil(q*float64(len(sorted))))-1))]
	}
	out.P50, out.P95, out.P99, out.P999, out.Max = at(0.50), at(0.95), at(0.99), at(0.999), sorted[len(sorted)-1]
	return out
}

// TestDiagPoint finds, untimed, the smallest ef at which an index grown from
// the first PE_ROWS rows of the dataset reaches a recall of 0.95 for the
// queries of the dataset, against their exact neighbors among those rows,
// which it computes. It writes the point to PE_POINT.
func TestDiagPoint(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_POINT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR and PE_POINT given")
	}
	const k = 10
	ctx := context.Background()
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	nightRows(t, train)
	queries, _, _ := readNightQueries(t, datasetDir, k)
	provider := distancer.NewCosineDistanceProvider()

	// The exact neighbors of every query among the rows of the index.
	type best struct {
		ids   [k]uint64
		dists [k]float32
		n     int
	}
	truth := make([]best, len(queries))
	const chunk = 10000
	var buf []byte
	for from := 0; from < train.rows; from += chunk {
		ids := make([]uint64, 0, chunk)
		for row := from; row < min(from+chunk, train.rows); row++ {
			ids = append(ids, uint64(row))
		}
		var vectors [][]float32
		vectors, buf, err = train.read(ids, buf)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		var next atomic.Int64
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for range runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0) {
			wg.Add(1)
			enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for {
					q := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
					if q >= len(queries) {
						return
					}
					b := &truth[q]
					for i, vec := range vectors {
						dist, _ := provider.SingleDist(queries[q], vec)
						if b.n == k && dist >= b.dists[k-1] {
							continue
						}
						at := b.n
						if b.n < k {
							b.n++
						} else {
							at = k - 1
						}
						for at > 0 && b.dists[at-1] > dist {
							b.ids[at], b.dists[at] = b.ids[at-1], b.dists[at-1]
							at--
						}
						b.ids[at], b.dists[at] = ids[i], dist
					}
				}
			}, logrus.New())
		}
		wg.Wait()
	}

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}()
	p.mu.RLock()
	live := p.g.meta.Live
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	require.Equal(t, train.rows, live, "the index holds the rows the neighbors were computed over")

	at := func(ef int) (float64, float64) {
		searching := uc
		searching.EF = ef
		require.NoError(t, p.UpdateUserConfig(searching, func() {}))
		var next, hits, loads atomic.Int64
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		errs := make([]error, 8)
		for worker := range 8 {
			wg.Add(1)
			enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for {
					q := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
					if q >= len(queries) {
						return
					}
					var stats diskSearchStats
					p.mu.RLock()
					found, _, err := p.g.search(ctx, queries[q], k, &stats)
					p.mu.RUnlock()
					if err != nil {
						errs[worker] = err
						return
					}
					for _, want := range truth[q].ids[:truth[q].n] {
						if slices.Contains(found, want) {
							hits.Add(1)
						}
					}
					loads.Add(int64(stats.Postings))
				}
			}, logger)
		}
		wg.Wait()
		for _, err := range errs {
			require.NoError(t, err)
		}
		recall := float64(hits.Load()) / float64(len(queries)*k)
		t.Logf("ef %d: recall %.4f, %.2f loads", ef, recall, float64(loads.Load())/float64(len(queries)))
		return recall, float64(loads.Load()) / float64(len(queries))
	}
	const target = 0.95
	low, high := k-1, k
	recall, loads := at(high)
	for recall < target {
		low, high = high, 2*high
		require.LessOrEqual(t, high, 4096, "the index does not reach recall %.2f", target)
		recall, loads = at(high)
	}
	for high-low > 1 {
		mid := (low + high) / 2
		if r, l := at(mid); r >= target {
			high, recall, loads = mid, r, l
		} else {
			low = mid
		}
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, map[string]any{
		"dir": dir, "dataset": datasetDir, "rows": train.rows, "queries": len(queries), "k": k, "target": target,
		"ef": high, "recall": recall, "loads": loads,
	})
}

// TestDiagQueries times read-only queries over a clone of an index, alone
// or next to callers that insert, for PE_SECONDS: PE_QTHREADS goroutines
// search the queries of the dataset one after another at PE_EF, each query
// admitted as in a shard, and PE_CALLERS callers add batches of 100 with a
// flush after every round, as TestDiagInserts does (0 for none). Of every
// query it keeps its latency, and how much of it was the wait for the index
// (its lock for reading) and how much the search. The store has its cycles.
func TestDiagQueries(t *testing.T) {
	datasetDir, dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DATASET"), os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if datasetDir == "" || dir == "" || out == "" || os.Getenv("PE_EF") == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DATASET, PE_DIR, PE_OUT and PE_EF given")
	}
	const k = 10
	ctx := context.Background()
	ef := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_EF", 0))
	queryThreads := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_QTHREADS", 1))
	callers := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_CALLERS", 0))
	lasting := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SECONDS", 60)) * time.Second
	n := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_NVECTORS", 60000))
	seed := uint64(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SEED", 7))
	train, err := openNightTrain(datasetDir)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer train.file.Close()
	datasetRows := nightRows(t, train)
	queries, _, _ := readNightQueries(t, datasetDir, k)

	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	uc.EF = ef
	st := openDiagStore(t, dir, logger, true)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	noMaintenance := diagNoMaintenance(&cfg)
	clocks, hooksOff := diagHooks(&cfg, true, false)
	defer hooksOff()
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	settled := diagSettle(t, dir)
	shut := func() {
		if p == nil {
			return
		}
		require.NoError(t, p.Flush())
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		st.stopCycles(ctx)
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
		p = nil
	}
	defer shut()
	var ids []uint64
	var vectors [][]float32
	if callers > 0 {
		ids, vectors = diagVectors(t, p, train, datasetRows, datasetDir, "repeated", n, seed)
	}
	p.mu.RLock()
	meta := p.g.meta
	p.mu.RUnlock()

	limiter := queryadmission.New(prometheus.NewRegistry(), queryadmission.Config{})
	type sample struct{ total, wait, search time.Duration }
	// search runs one query and tells its latency, the part of it that was
	// the wait for the lock of the index, and the postings it loaded.
	search := func(q int) (sample, int, error) {
		var stats diskSearchStats
		start := time.Now()
		searchCtx, release, err := limiter.Admit(ctx, concurrency.TimesGOMAXPROCS(2))
		if err != nil {
			return sample{}, 0, err
		}
		asked := time.Now()
		p.mu.RLock()
		held := time.Now()
		_, _, err = p.g.search(searchCtx, queries[q], k, &stats)
		p.mu.RUnlock()
		end := time.Now()
		release()
		return sample{total: end.Sub(start), wait: held.Sub(asked), search: end.Sub(held)}, stats.Postings, err
	}
	// Warm: every query once, with 8 threads, before anything is timed.
	{
		var next atomic.Int64
		warming := enterrors.NewErrorGroupWrapper(logger)
		for range 8 {
			warming.Go(func() error {
				for {
					q := int(next.Add(1)) - 1
					if q >= len(queries) {
						return nil
					}
					if _, _, err := search(q); err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
			})
		}
		require.NoError(t, warming.Wait())
	}

	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(out+".started", []byte(time.Now().Format("15:04:05")+"\n"), 0o644))
	usageBefore, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	runtimeBefore := readDiagMetrics()
	var clocksBefore map[string]int64
	if clocks != nil {
		clocksBefore = clocks()
	}
	var gcBefore runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&gcBefore)
	begin := time.Now()
	deadline := begin.Add(lasting)

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	var failMu sync.Mutex
	var failure error
	fail := func(err error) {
		failMu.Lock()
		if failure == nil {
			failure = err
		}
		failMu.Unlock()
	}
	inserted, insertSeconds, rounds := 0, 0.0, 0
	if callers > 0 {
		wg.Add(1)
		enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			const batch = 100
			for at := 0; at < n && time.Now().Before(deadline); {
				to := min(at+batch*callers, n)
				adding := enterrors.NewErrorGroupWrapper(logger)
				for start := at; start < to; start += batch {
					end := min(start+batch, to)
					adding.Go(func() error { return p.AddBatch(ctx, ids[start:end], vectors[start:end]) })
				}
				err := adding.Wait()
				if err == nil {
					err = p.Flush()
				}
				if err != nil {
					fail(err)
					return
				}
				at = to
				inserted, rounds = to, rounds+1
				insertSeconds = time.Since(begin).Seconds()
			}
		}, logger)
	}
	perThread := make([][]sample, queryThreads)
	var loads atomic.Int64
	var next atomic.Int64
	for worker := range queryThreads {
		wg.Add(1)
		enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
				q := int(next.Add(1)-1) % len(queries)
				s, loaded, err := search(q)
				if err != nil {
					fail(err)
					return
				}
				loads.Add(int64(loaded))
				perThread[worker] = append(perThread[worker], s)
			}
		}, logger)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	took := time.Since(begin)
	require.NoError(t, failure, "the pass failed")
	usage, err := readDiagRusage()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var gcAfter runtime.MemStats
	runtime.ReadMemStats(&gcAfter)
	var clocksAfter map[string]int64
	if clocks != nil {
		clocksAfter = clocks()
	}

	var totals, waits, searches []time.Duration
	for _, samples := range perThread {
		for _, s := range samples {
			totals, waits, searches = append(totals, s.total), append(waits, s.wait), append(searches, s.search)
		}
	}
	// How many queries waited for the lock of the index longer than 1 ms and
	// longer than 10 ms.
	over1, over10 := 0, 0
	for _, w := range waits {
		if w > time.Millisecond {
			over1++
		}
		if w > 10*time.Millisecond {
			over10++
		}
	}
	result := map[string]any{
		"dir": dir, "dataset": datasetDir, "rows": train.rows, "cacheMode": uc.RQ.CacheMode, "meta": meta,
		"ef": ef, "k": k, "queryThreads": queryThreads, "callers": callers, "seconds": took.Seconds(),
		"noMaintenance": noMaintenance, "settleSeconds": settled,
		"gomaxprocs": runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0), "pid": os.Getpid(),
		"queries": len(totals), "qps": float64(len(totals)) / took.Seconds(),
		"latency": diagPercentilesOf(totals), "lockWait": diagPercentilesOf(waits), "search": diagPercentilesOf(searches),
		"lockWaitsOver1ms": over1, "lockWaitsOver10ms": over10,
		"loadsPerQuery": float64(loads.Load()) / float64(max(len(totals), 1)),
		"inserted":      inserted, "insertRounds": rounds, "insertSeconds": insertSeconds,
		"numGC":        gcAfter.NumGC - gcBefore.NumGC,
		"clocksBefore": clocksBefore, "clocksAfter": clocksAfter,
		"rusageBefore": usageBefore, "rusageAfter": usage,
		"runtimeBefore": runtimeBefore, "runtimeAfter": readDiagMetrics(),
	}
	if insertSeconds > 0 {
		result["insertsPerSecond"] = float64(inserted) / insertSeconds
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, result)
	latency, wait := diagPercentilesOf(totals), diagPercentilesOf(waits)
	t.Logf("%d query threads, %d callers inserting, %s: %d queries, p50 %.3f ms, p99 %.3f, max %.1f | the wait for the "+
		"index: p50 %.3f ms, p99 %.3f, max %.1f, %d over 1 ms | %d inserted in %.1f s", queryThreads, callers,
		took.Round(time.Second), len(totals), latency.P50, latency.P99, latency.Max, wait.P50, wait.P99, wait.Max, over1,
		inserted, insertSeconds)
}

// TestDiagDegree counts the edges of an index: of every posting that is
// alive, as a search fetches it, how many edges each of its members has,
// how many of them lead to a member of the same posting, and how many
// endpoints they lead to in all. It opens the index with no cycle and no
// maintenance, and writes nothing.
func TestDiagDegree(t *testing.T) {
	dir, out := os.Getenv("PE_DIR"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if dir == "" || out == "" || os.Getenv("PE_DEGREE") == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_DIR, PE_OUT and PE_DEGREE given")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	logger := logrus.New()
	logger.SetLevel(logrus.WarnLevel)
	uc := ent.NewDefaultUserConfig()
	uc.RQ.CacheMode = nightEnv("PE_CACHE", ent.CacheModeRouting)
	st := openNightStore(t, dir, logger, false)
	cfg := st.config(dir, logger, 0)
	cfg.noMaintenance = true
	p, err := Open(cfg, uc, st.store)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer func() {
		require.NoError(t, p.Shutdown(ctx))
		require.NoError(t, st.store.Shutdown(ctx))
	}()

	begin := time.Now()
	p.mu.RLock()
	g := p.g
	postingOf := g.st.side.postingOf
	var postings, members, edges, same, distinct, noEdges int
	histogram := make([]int, 65)
	maxDegree := 0
	seen := map[uint32]struct{}{}
	var round diskRound
	var problem error
	const chunk = 32
	picks := make([]scored, 0, chunk)
	flush := func() {
		if len(picks) == 0 || problem != nil {
			picks = picks[:0]
			return
		}
		if err := g.fetch(&round, picks); err != nil {
			problem = err
			return
		}
		for i, pick := range picks {
			post := &round.postings[i].post
			postings++
			members += len(post.docIDs)
			clear(seen)
			for m := range post.docIDs {
				list := post.edgesOf(m)
				edges += len(list)
				maxDegree = max(maxDegree, len(list))
				histogram[min(len(list), len(histogram)-1)]++
				if len(list) == 0 {
					noEdges++
				}
				for _, endpoint := range list {
					if postingOf[endpoint] == uint32(pick.id) {
						same++
					}
					seen[endpoint] = struct{}{}
				}
			}
			distinct += len(seen)
		}
		picks = picks[:0]
	}
	for q := 0; q < g.meta.Postings; q++ {
		if g.retired[q] || g.size[q] == 0 {
			continue
		}
		picks = append(picks, scored{id: uint64(q)})
		if len(picks) == chunk {
			flush()
		}
	}
	flush()
	meta := g.meta
	p.mu.RUnlock()
	require.NoError(t, problem)

	writeNightJSON(t, out, map[string]any{
		"dir": dir, "meta": meta, "postings": postings, "members": members, "edges": edges,
		"edgesPerVector":              float64(edges) / float64(max(members, 1)),
		"membersPerPosting":           float64(members) / float64(max(postings, 1)),
		"edgesToTheSamePosting":       float64(same) / float64(max(edges, 1)),
		"distinctEndpointsPerPosting": float64(distinct) / float64(max(postings, 1)),
		"membersWithNoEdge":           noEdges, "maxDegree": maxDegree, "histogram": histogram,
		"seconds": time.Since(begin).Seconds(),
	})
	t.Logf("%d postings, %d members, %d edges: %.2f edges a vector (most %d), %.1f %% of them to the same posting, "+
		"%.0f distinct endpoints a posting", postings, members, edges, float64(edges)/float64(max(members, 1)), maxDegree,
		100*float64(same)/float64(max(edges, 1)), float64(distinct)/float64(max(postings, 1)))
}

// TestDiagTables times, with no index, what the traversal of a search reads
// by doc id, at the sizes of the two indexes of the diagnostic: for every
// edge the posting of its endpoint and whether that posting is loaded, and
// the visited set (the loop of collectEndpoints); and for every member the
// mark of a deleted vector. PE_TABLES lists the cases as keys:edges:members,
// with commas: how many doc ids the tables cover, and the edges and the
// members of one search. The doc ids are drawn at random over the keys.
func TestDiagTables(t *testing.T) {
	out, cases := os.Getenv("PE_OUT"), os.Getenv("PE_TABLES")
	if out == "" || cases == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_OUT and PE_TABLES given")
	}
	searches := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_SEARCHES", 64))
	var threadCounts []int
	for _, field := range strings.Split(nightEnv("PE_TABLETHREADS", "1,8"), ",") {
		threads, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(field))
		require.NoError(t, err, "PE_TABLETHREADS")
		threadCounts = append(threadCounts, threads)
	}
	var results []map[string]any
	for _, field := range strings.Split(cases, ",") {
		parts := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(field), ":")
		require.Len(t, parts, 3, "PE_TABLES is keys:edges:members")
		keys, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[0])
		require.NoError(t, err)
		edgesPer, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[1])
		require.NoError(t, err)
		membersPer, err := strconv.Atoi(parts[2])
		require.NoError(t, err)
		postings := max(keys/250, 1)
		rng := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(uint64(keys), uint64(edgesPer)))
		postingOf := make([]uint32, keys)
		for i := range postingOf {
			postingOf[i] = uint32(rng.IntN(postings))
		}
		deleted := make([]bool, keys)
		for _, threads := range threadCounts {
			pool := visited.NewPool(keys)
			type own struct {
				edges, members           []uint32
				loaded                   []bool
				unscored                 []uint32
				visitNs, markNs, resetNs int64
				kept, gone               int
			}
			workers := make([]*own, threads)
			for w := range workers {
				o := &own{loaded: make([]bool, postings)}
				local := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(uint64(w+1), uint64(keys)))
				// A search has about 100 postings loaded at the end.
				for range 100 {
					o.loaded[local.IntN(postings)] = true
				}
				o.edges = make([]uint32, searches*edgesPer)
				for i := range o.edges {
					o.edges[i] = uint32(local.IntN(keys))
				}
				o.members = make([]uint32, searches*membersPer)
				for i := range o.members {
					o.members[i] = uint32(local.IntN(keys))
				}
				workers[w] = o
			}
			var wg sync.WaitGroup
			begin := time.Now()
			for _, o := range workers {
				wg.Add(1)
				enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
					defer wg.Done()
					// Twice: the first round only warms the tables and the set.
					for round := range 2 {
						var visitNs, markNs, resetNs int64
						kept, gone := 0, 0
						for s := range searches {
							set := pool.Borrow()
							clock := time.Now()
							o.unscored = o.unscored[:0]
							for _, endpoint := range o.edges[s*edgesPer : (s+1)*edgesPer] {
								if o.loaded[postingOf[endpoint]] || set.CheckAndVisit(uint64(endpoint)) {
									continue
								}
								o.unscored = append(o.unscored, endpoint)
							}
							visitNs += int64(time.Since(clock))
							kept += len(o.unscored)
							clock = time.Now()
							for _, member := range o.members[s*membersPer : (s+1)*membersPer] {
								if deleted[member] {
									gone++
								}
							}
							markNs += int64(time.Since(clock))
							clock = time.Now()
							pool.Return(set)
							resetNs += int64(time.Since(clock))
						}
						if round == 1 {
							o.visitNs, o.markNs, o.resetNs, o.kept, o.gone = visitNs, markNs, resetNs, kept, gone
						}
					}
				}, logrus.New())
			}
			wg.Wait()
			var visitNs, markNs, resetNs int64
			kept := 0
			for _, o := range workers {
				visitNs, markNs, resetNs, kept = visitNs+o.visitNs, markNs+o.markNs, resetNs+o.resetNs, kept+o.kept
			}
			all := float64(threads * searches)
			result := map[string]any{
				"keys": keys, "postings": postings, "edgesPerSearch": edgesPer, "membersPerSearch": membersPer,
				"threads": threads, "searches": searches,
				"nsPerEdge":        float64(visitNs) / (all * float64(edgesPer)),
				"nsPerMemberMark":  float64(markNs) / (all * float64(membersPer)),
				"resetNsPerSearch": float64(resetNs) / all,
				"resetNsPerEdge":   float64(resetNs) / (all * float64(edgesPer)),
				"keptPerSearch":    float64(kept) / all, "seconds": time.Since(begin).Seconds(),
			}
			results = append(results, result)
			t.Logf("%d keys, %d edges and %d members a search, %d threads: %.2f ns an edge (posting of the endpoint, "+
				"loaded, visited), %.2f ns the mark of a member alone, the reset %.2f ns an edge", keys, edgesPer,
				membersPer, threads, result["nsPerEdge"], result["nsPerMemberMark"], result["resetNsPerEdge"])
		}
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, results)
}

// TestDiagReads times positional reads of one record each at random places
// of a file, as the rescore reads the exact vectors: PE_READTHREADS
// goroutines at once (1,2,4,8,16,32,64), each cell at most PE_READS reads or
// PE_READSECONDS seconds, in three ways: as the index reads (goroutines and
// ReadAt), with every goroutine tied to a thread of its own, and with the
// cache of the files of the system left out (F_NOCACHE). No two reads of the
// whole test touch the same 16 KiB of the file, so that none finds what
// another brought to the cache: give it a file whose cache is cold.
func TestDiagReads(t *testing.T) {
	path, out := os.Getenv("PE_FILE"), os.Getenv("PE_OUT")
	if path == "" || out == "" {
		t.Skip("no PE_FILE and PE_OUT given")
	}
	record := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_RECORD", 3072))
	perCell := int(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_READS", 20000))
	lasting := time.Duration(nightEnvInt(t, "PE_READSECONDS", 3)) * time.Second
	var threadCounts []int
	for _, field := range strings.Split(nightEnv("PE_READTHREADS", "1,2,4,8,16,32,64"), ",") {
		threads, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(field))
		require.NoError(t, err, "PE_READTHREADS")
		threadCounts = append(threadCounts, threads)
	}
	info, err := os.Stat(path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	const page = 16 << 10
	pages := int(info.Size() / page)
	modes := []string{"goroutines", "threads", "nocache"}
	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, pages, len(modes)*len(threadCounts)*perCell, "the file has a page for every read")
	// The pages of the file in a random order: every read takes the next.
	order := rand.New(rand.NewPCG(11, 13)).Perm(pages)
	var nextPage atomic.Int64

	var results []map[string]any
	for _, mode := range modes {
		file, err := os.Open(path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		if mode == "nocache" {
			_, _, errno := syscall.Syscall(syscall.SYS_FCNTL, file.Fd(), syscall.F_NOCACHE, 1)
			require.Zero(t, errno, "F_NOCACHE")
		}
		for _, threads := range threadCounts {
			var done atomic.Int64
			latencies := make([][]time.Duration, threads)
			errs := make([]error, threads)
			var wg sync.WaitGroup
			begin := time.Now()
			deadline := begin.Add(lasting)
			for worker := range threads {
				wg.Add(1)
				enterrors.GoWrapper(func() {
					defer wg.Done()
					if mode == "threads" {
						runtime.LockOSThread()
						defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
					}
					buf := make([]byte, record)
					for done.Add(1) <= int64(perCell) && time.Now().Before(deadline) {
						at := int64(order[nextPage.Add(1)-1]) * page
						clock := time.Now()
						if _, err := file.ReadAt(buf, at); err != nil {
							errs[worker] = err
							return
						}
						latencies[worker] = append(latencies[worker], time.Since(clock))
					}
				}, logrus.New())
			}
			wg.Wait()
			took := time.Since(begin)
			for _, err := range errs {
				require.NoError(t, err)
			}
			var all []time.Duration
			for _, own := range latencies {
				all = append(all, own...)
			}
			// A read that took under 20 us did not reach the disk.
			cached := 0
			var busy time.Duration
			for _, l := range all {
				busy += l
				if l < 20*time.Microsecond {
					cached++
				}
			}
			result := map[string]any{
				"mode": mode, "threads": threads, "reads": len(all), "seconds": took.Seconds(),
				"readsPerSecond": float64(len(all)) / took.Seconds(), "latency": diagPercentilesOf(all),
				"inFlight": busy.Seconds() / took.Seconds(), "under20us": cached,
			}
			results = append(results, result)
			l := diagPercentilesOf(all)
			t.Logf("%s, %d at once: %d reads in %s, %.0f a second | p50 %.3f ms, p99 %.3f | %.2f in flight on "+
				"average | %d under 20 us", mode, threads, len(all), took.Round(time.Millisecond),
				float64(len(all))/took.Seconds(), l.P50, l.P99, busy.Seconds()/took.Seconds(), cached)
		}
		require.NoError(t, file.Close())
	}
	writeNightJSON(t, out, map[string]any{"file": path, "bytes": info.Size(), "record": record, "cells": results})
}
